bot.name: Infested Artosis
bot.description: A Zerg bot with economic and aggressive openings, combat simulation, and opponent-history learning. Human difficulty is not yet calibrated.

formats.notes: Local x86/x64 SC:R tested on Fighting Spirit with the corrected BWAPI Zerg morph bridge.

mapConstraints: Legacy SC:R unit limits required by the experimental bridge.

learning.notes: Chooses openings using bounded opponent history in the local working copy. Reset learning restores an empty history.

license.name: MIT
license.notes: Bot MIT notice credits Jasper Geurtz and Brad Ewing. Patched source and dependency notices are included.

localDistribution.evidence: Reviewed pinned MIT sources, dependency notices, modified-source archive and offline rebuild. https://github.com/ShieldBattery/robotics-facility/blob/infested-artosis-sb-1/docs/infested-artosis-admission.md

publicCompetition.evidence: Track separately from local distribution; author outreach planned by Travis.

limitations: Requires ShieldBattery BWAPI bridge with the Zerg morph/completion correction (46ef63a6d or later).
Java 21 x64 required, including with x86 SC:R.
Zerg 1v1 tested on Fighting Spirit; other maps and formats remain unverified.
Human difficulty has not been calibrated.

sourceReview.evidence: Reviewed source effects, isolated storage, exact package, offline rebuild, x86/x64 gameplay and sampled runtime effects; not an OS sandbox certification. https://github.com/ShieldBattery/robotics-facility/blob/infested-artosis-sb-1/docs/infested-artosis-admission.md
